# DSH Studio v0.9.17

## New features

- Add a debug-only WebView2 acceptance entry point and CDP runner for the real Tauri renderer, native IPC, screenshots, and minimum-window checks. Release builds do not expose a debugging port.

## Changes and security

- Resolve every official `@deepseek-ai/*` module from the single qualified managed Harness while leaving third-party packages Profile-owned. Older transitive Profile copies can no longer mix storage schemas, service contracts, or ESM exports with `0.1.7-rc.2`.
- Cross-check every literal renderer invocation against both the Tauri handler registry and the reviewed shell ACL. A missing handler or permission now blocks the release.
- Keep incompatible third-party plugins contained by the existing peer-compatibility gate instead of weakening version checks to make startup appear successful.

## Fixes and polish

- Repair the invalid root `[]` followed by list rows that `0.9.16` could write while changing the default Agent Preset. The first `0.9.17` start preserves a backup and repairs that exact shape without deleting session caches or third-party Profile data.
- Allow the registered `desktop_file_offer` command through the shell ACL, fixing `Command desktop_file_offer not allowed by ACL` for operating-system open and dropped `.dshpreset` files.
- Close Windows terminal tabs without surfacing the reversed `portable-pty` result as `os error 258`, while independently verifying that the original child exited.
- Remove a stale recovery notice when the same Profile later reaches readiness, while preserving evidence when another last-known-good Profile recovered.
- Return the computed SHA-256 Profile-backup verification result to the import preview instead of labelling a verified current export as legacy.

## Installation

- All `0.9.16` users should upgrade in place to `0.9.17`; the affected Profile patch is repaired automatically during startup.
- Upgrade in place or use the signed in-app updater. Full keeps the pinned offline Node, Harness, and pnpm payload; Lite downloads verified dependencies from official sources when needed.
- Windows ships installer and portable builds, Linux ships AppImage, DEB, and RPM, and macOS ships native Full images plus a universal Lite image.

## Verification

- Production build, lint, 285 frontend tests at 95.1% statement coverage, 63 packaging and contract tests, 420 Rust tests, accessibility checks, public-contract checks, and bilingual and website documentation checks passed locally.
- A real Windows WebView2 session covered Harness stop/start, every workbench page, terminal create/close, session search and reading, registry search, LAN remote open/QR/close, every startup setting with exact rollback, Profile create/copy/compare/rename/export/verify/import/remove, themes, presentation modes, sidebar, command palette, recovery dismissal, and the 900×620 minimum layout.
- The repaired real Profile repeatedly reached `ready` on Harness `0.1.7-rc.2`; native file offers and Profile integrity results were also rechecked through the real renderer.
